correctness.rationale: One-to-one correspondence between length-four palindromic windows and fixed transitions at diagonal de Bruijn vertices. The loop bbb cannot follow itself in a nontrivial Euler tour, forcing each sigma_b to move at least two symbols. Every prescribed family sigma_b(b) != b is realized through an Eulerian macrograph on off-diagonal pairs; macroedges partition the original q^3 edges and the macrograph is balanced and contains the strongly connected directed line graph of the complete loopless digraph. Cyclic Euler-tour expansion yields exact spectrum. Python literal-window checks q=2..8; independent exhaustive C++ count of 373248 order-three ternary cycles. No finite computation substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Natural first-window palindrome counting invariant in universal cycles is now sharply bounded and has a complete gapless spectrum for every alphabet size. The constructive simultaneous transition-prescription lemma explains attainability and provides an extensible structural method, rather than an unmotivated finite census. It isolates an exact q=2 obstruction and q>=3 degrees of freedom.
